title: Tagalog basics
about: The most common words of everyday Tagalog (wordfreq counts for Filipino, grouped by root with the app's Tagalog analyzer and tools/course/tl/rank.mjs), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places, and English words, are left out. Verbs are shown in the form a learner says them (kumain, magluto), adjectives with their ma- (maganda). Each word has one short everyday sentence in the Tagalog of Manila, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word.
